eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 4:17 PM on AUG 31, 2026 Effective until 2:17 AM SEP 1, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Mohave County Sheriff's Office. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Mohave County Sheriff's Office is looking for a white male, Michael Leon Hopkins, 65-years-old, approximately 5 feet 8 inches tall and weighing 164 pounds, with blonde hair and blue eyes. He was last seen wearing light blue jeans, dark blue t-shirt with pocket, and a Route 66 baseball cap. Michael Leon Hopkins of Golden Valley, was last seen at his residence in the 3400 block of N Lochiel Road at approximately 2:00 pm on Sunday (8/30). He left the residence in his vehicle, listed as a white 2021 Ram 3500 (Arizona plate: handicap-RYA5TD) with a large dent on the passenger side. His vehicle was last seen traveling westbound I-40 at the Arizona/California border at approximately 5:55 pm on Sunday (8/30). Michael has multiple medical conditions that may cause confusion, raising concern for his safety and well-being. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
